title: Credentials and secret files
summary: Stop Claude's own file tools from reading or editing SSH keys, cloud credentials, .env files and private keys.
tradeoffs: Legitimate *.key files in a project are blocked too
cannot: Covers Claude's built-in file tools and the file commands it recognizes in Bash (cat, head, sed, ...). A Python script that opens a file itself is not covered. For OS-level blocking, add 80-sandbox.
